Name: Nyapu Style Downhill Project
Author: susurrusshivers
Description:
This replaces the portraits for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project - Expanded Map for Custom NPCs[/url] with pixel art by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=description]Nyapu[/url] that has been custom edited by me to suit the new NPCs added by Downhill Project. The portraits were done similarly to how [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nugmods/mods?gameId=1303]nugmods[/url] has been making their portraits: I used Nyapu's original pixel art and made personal edits by hand to create Downhill's priest Anderson, the coal miner Arthur, and Miss Julia.

Please support both [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Kiyugamods?gameId=1303]Kiyugamods[/url]! They are both very generous in allowing me permission to make these portraits and are both doing wonderful work.


[b]Installation:[/b]
1. Download "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project - Expanded Map for Custom NPCs[/url]" and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and place in your Mods folder.
2. Download the file on this mod page and drag and drop into your Mods folder. (Thanks for the help here Kiyugamods!)
3. Enjoy!

Permissions: Anyone is free to make edits of these portraits that they would like, please just credit myself, Nyapu, and Kiyugamods if you publish.

Downloads.Description: Fixed the content file that didn't have a replacement for the Arthur portrait. All should be working now.
